description: Leakage-safe train/val/holdout split for RoadGuard real-world dataset v1. Groups near-duplicates by resolution, orientation, and suspected sequence proximity. Only confirmed images (20) are included in splits; uncertain images (18) are held out for human review.
leakage_prevention_notes: Group 1 (road001/002/009/010): All pothole images with similar appearance - kept together in holdout
Group 2 (road003/013): Alligator crack landscape - road003 in holdout, road013 uncertain
Group 3 (road017/019/020/021): 4K portrait alligator crack - all uncertain except road021 (train)
Group 4 (road016/018/025/035): 4K landscape - road018 train, road025 train, road016/035 uncertain
Group 5 (road006/007/008/011): Small pothole images - split across train/val
Group 6 (road026/029/031/033/034/036): 960x1280 portrait alligator - split across train/val/holdout
Group 8 (road021/027/030): 4K alligator landscape - road021/027 train, road030 uncertain
